Lemma
[Newtonian representation] 1. ch7:7.14\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0173, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0174 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0174 If $u\in W_0^{1,1}(\Omega )$, then \begin{equation} \tag {7.36} u(x)=\frac1{n\omega _n}\int _\Omega \frac{(x_i-y_i)D_i u(y)}{|x-y|^n}\, dy \quad \text{for almost every }x\in \Omega , \end{equation} and hence \begin{equation} \tag {7.37} |u|\leq \frac1{n\omega _n}V_{1/n}|Du|. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch For $u\in C_0^1(\Omega )$, integrate the directional derivative of $u$ along every ray from $x$ and average over the unit sphere. This gives (7.36); density and Lemma 7.12 pass the identity to $W_0^{1,1}(\Omega )$. Taking absolute values yields (7.37).

□
